train_model_CLEP: run the CLEP model training loop with Hydra config and optional SLURM job submission
run_train_Lite: run the EgoLanguageAssociation model training with AdamW optimizer and cosine annealing scheduler
run_eval_Lite: run evaluation on Kinetics and EgoCharades datasets and return accuracy metrics as key-value pairs
run_ego_charades_Lite: run multi-class classification evaluation on the EgoCharades dataset with configurable ego-only and sentence options
run_eval_kinetics_Lite: run classification evaluation on the Kinetics dataset and return top-1 and top-5 accuracy scores
